_leewayHeader.purpose: Define deterministic Agent Lee teaching, assessment, remediation, and receipt behavior.
_leewayHeader.inputs: Learner identity, tenant, role, product version, curriculum, manual, and rubric.
_leewayHeader.outputs: Grounded teaching, score, remediation, and training receipt.
_leewayHeader.dependencies: Manual, curriculum, assessment, knowledge, and permission manifests.
_leewayHeader.tests: Source-grounding tests, rubric tests, role tests, and receipt validation.
_leewayHeader.securityImpact: Prevents answer-key leakage and tenant-data exposure.
_leewayHeader.databaseImpact: Future training records require tenant-aware persistence.
